license_spdx.description: SPDX id of the weights' licence as verified by the packager (ADR 0013/0014 evidence rules).

production_approved.description:
Owner gate: false until the owner approves the model for production (unknown training data, unverified licence). The server refuses an
unapproved model unless started with an explicit override.

tensors.description: Weight tensors with byte offsets into their payload (the LLM `LayerMapping`, reused).

Activation.description:
The MLP activation. Only the values the runtime implements exist; a model with another activation
needs a new variant here and a kernel, never a guess.

AttentionKind.description:
How the attention layers lay out their KV cache. Decides the geometry that
`num_kv_heads` and `head_dim` describe; a variant with a different cache
shape (e.g. latent attention) is added here, never guessed from the dims.

subsample.description: Total time downsampling of the convolutions (8 for three stride-2 layers).

window_frames_min.description: Attention window in encoder frames, shortest and longest (bidirectional inside the window).

AudioFrontend.description: Audio front end exactly as the reference defines it (`helios-audio::mel::MelConfig` is built from this).

chunk_seconds.description: Longest chunk the front end hands to the encoder, in seconds.

frame_rate_milli_hz.description: Frames per second times 1000 (12.5 Hz is 12500), an integer so the manifest has no float to compare.

LayerMapping.description:
Maps one transformer layer to its weight tensor(s) inside the package blob.
Byte offsets let the loader mmap the blob and slice without copying.

byte_length.description: Length in bytes of the weight blob for this tensor.

byte_offset.description: Byte range where this tensor's weights begin, counted from the start of the data section of its payload file.

index.description: 0-based layer index in the model graph.

name.description: Logical name, e.g. "attention.q_proj" — matches the kernel registry.

payload.description:
Index into the manifest's payload table of the file that holds this tensor (0, the default,
is the first or only payload).

sharding.description: How the tensor may be split between tensor-parallel ranks (ADR 0005). Absent means it is not split.

ModelConfig.description:
Architecture dimensions of the compiled model. All fields are required except `attention_scale`: a
manifest that cannot say how big its tensors are, or which variant of each operation they feed, is
not loadable. The runtime reads these and nothing else about the model's shape.

attention_scale.description: Softmax scale override. Absent means `1 / sqrt(head_dim)`.

intermediate_size.description: Width of the MLP's inner (gate and up) projections.

max_seq_len.description:
Maximum sequence length the model was compiled with. Requests beyond
this are rejected to avoid KV cache overrun.

num_kv_heads.description: Number of key/value heads (equals `num_attention_heads` without GQA).

qk_norm.description:
Q and K are normalised per head before RoPE (Qwen3). A runtime that does not implement it
refuses the package with a typed error.

qkv_bias.description: The Q, K and V projections have a bias.

rope_style.description: How rotary embedding pairs dimensions; see [`RopeStyle`].

rope_theta.description: Base of the rotary embedding frequencies.

tie_word_embeddings.description: The output head is the embedding matrix (no `lm_head.weight` tensor).

ModelFamily.description: Families that use this envelope. `decoder_lm` is the implicit family of the LLM manifest and is deliberately not a variant.

Payload.description:
One weights file of the package. The file sits beside the package under exactly this name; the
name is part of what is signed, so a swapped or edited file is detectable once the runtime
checks `sha256` (planned with package signing; the runtime does not verify it yet).

byte_length.description: Size of the file in bytes.

file.description: File name only: no directory separator, no `:`, not `.` or `..`. See [`is_bare_file_name`].

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the whole file.

QualifiedCheckpoint.description: The public checkpoint a package was made from.

revision.description: The git commit of that repository, 40 lowercase hex digits. The weights' hashes are in `payloads`.

RopeStyle.description: How rotary position embedding pairs the dimensions of a head.

oneOf.description: Hugging Face `rotate_half` (GPT-NeoX): dimension `i` pairs with `i + head_dim / 2`; the whole head is rotated.

ShardClass.description: How the tensor of a layer entry may be split between tensor-parallel ranks.

oneOf.description: Split along the output dimension (rows of a `[out, in]` matrix, and a bias with them): Q, K, V, gate, up.

Split along the input dimension (columns): the attention output projection and the MLP down projection. A bias of a row-split
projection is added once, after the all-reduce, never per rank.
Every rank holds the whole tensor: norms.
Split along the vocabulary rows, which the loader pads to a multiple of `tp * 64`: the embedding and the output head.
Audio encoder (conv2d subsampling + transformer) whose output is spliced into a Qwen3 decoder's input embeddings.

audio_token_id.description: Token id of the placeholder whose embedding row is replaced by an encoder frame (the splice rule of the reference).

decoder.description: The decoder is a complete `decoder_lm` description, so the unchanged LLM path serves it.

TensorFormat.description:
Weight packing format of a package. Per-tensor dtypes live in
[`TensorMetadata`]; this is the package-level format the recipe selected.

TensorMetadata.description:
Shape + dtype of a single tensor. Mirrors `helios_hal::TensorData` but
stays decoupled from device pointers — this is on-package metadata only.

shape.description: Logical shape in row-major order, e.g. [4096, 4096].

oneOf.description: LLM backbone emitting multi-codebook codec frames, small depth decoder per frame, causal transformer codec.

voices.description: Preset voices the package ships; a request naming another voice is a 400 (cloning is not supported).
